title: Positive scalar curvature and codimension-two width
exact_target: For every $n\geq 4$, is the codimension-two Urysohn width of all connected complete smooth boundaryless n-manifolds with $Scal\geq 1$ bounded by one constant depending on n only? Urysohn width means the infimum of maximal fiber diameter over continuous maps to simplicial complexes of dimension $\leq n-2$.
